intro: Testing the Wells is an investigative task assigned by Alba Fairmoon to determine the source of poison seeping through Westfall's soil. Adventurers are sent with sampling kits to collect groundwater from the wells at the Jansen Stead and Molsen Farm.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: We must determine the source and nature of the poison corrupting this land. Let us begin with the groundwater under the farms in the area.
Go to the Jansen Stead and the Molsen Farm, and collect samples from the wells there.
